name: benai-skills
tagline_zh: 393个技能塞进一个货架，翻找比点外卖还快。从写代码到哄娃，总有一个让你今晚就想试。
tagline_en: 393 skills in one pack, faster to browse than ordering takeout. From coding to parenting, one will tempt you.
why_zh: 同类合集多是堆砌，它却按场景分好类，且每个技能都带真实示例，上手零门槛。
why_en: Unlike bloated packs, it's neatly categorized by use-case, each skill with a live demo—so you can start in seconds.
